होतृ m. (-ता)
 1. A priest who at a sacrifice recites the prayers of the
Rig-Veda; one conversant with the

. A sacrificer.
 f. (-त्री)
Adj. Sacrificing, offering oblation into fire.
 E. हु to sacrifice,
Unādi aff. तृच् ।

होत्र n. (-त्रं)
 1. An article intended or fit for offering with fire, generally
clarified butter.
 2. Burnt-offering, oblation with fire.
 f. (-त्रा) Praise.
E. हु to sacrifice, ष्ट्रन् aff., टाप् added in the feminine.

होत्रीय n. (-यं) A place where oblations are offered.
 m. (-यः) A priest
offering an oblation.
 E. होत्र an offering, छ aff.
